verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents its own check-deposit service: checks received in the mailbox are deposited without the customer visiting the bank. The deposit request is processed and the check mailed to the customer's bank within 1 business day, so the paper never reaches the founder. Endorsement handling and reconciliation (matching deposits to records or confirming funds) are not documented, and funds take up to a week because the check travels by mail. Missing for 10: documented endorsement handling, deposit reconciliation/confirmation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, checks that arrive in the mail get deposited to my bank account by the provider — endorsed, deposited, and reconciled without the paper touching my hands

citations.quote: Deposit any checks received in your mailbox without going to the bank. Pay per deposit with no setup or monthly fees.
Check deposit requests are processed and mailed out within 1 business day. Funds are usually processed by your bank within a week.
Get a VirtualPostMail (VPM) mailbox address to manage your mail, deposit checks, and handle shipments and returns.
